QuestInfo.name: [Fabian's Research] The Stars' Force
QuestInfo.0: Apparently a strange new material has been discovered at #b#m230050000##k amidst research regarding Star Force. It seems the researchers need help testing their hypothesis.
QuestInfo.1: #b#p2300001##k and #b#p9201664##k tell you about a condensed form of Star Force called a #b#t4037448##k. It is composed of #b#t4037446#s#k, but there aren't enough at the research center right now. Bring a #b#t2830545##k to #b#p9201664##k.
QuestInfo.2: You delivered the #b#t2830545##k to #b#p9201664##k, who completed the #b#t4037448##k. He said that as long as you bring him more materials, he'd gladly make more #t4037448#s for you. How convenient!
